opaque_observation: X00 through X37 from one independent full-inventory shuffle, never role-sorted blocks; exact word and paragraph boundaries retained
typed_baseline: same source, typed value key and word order; L/S/W card identities supplied only to the isolated typed-baseline job
paragraph_unit: maximal contiguous exact citation runs with occurrence suffixes for noncontiguous label reuse
reference: byte-identical GDT833 native Monarchia reference and candidates, with family factor OFF
unused_rule_policy: Rules absent from discovery and held remain unidentifiable and unscored; active counts are not role-blind fitter inputs
normalization: unchanged hash-bound GDT832 normalization and exact annotation joins; preserve every representable ordered word, exclude a whole citation run on an unrepresentable alphabetic word
gold_policy: original normalized Epistolae spelling; no v/u collapse
truth_policy: typed/opaque aliasing, roles, outputs and plaintext stay sealed until all fits are locked
